scope: independent rational oracle for finite binary64 convex Q4 / axis-aligned rectangle overlap only; no FE or self-contact validation

frozen_before_first_execution.failure_policy: record every failure; do not tune seed, samples, or thresholds after the run

independence.oracle: Fraction.from_float input promotion; contained Q4 vertices + contained rectangle corners + 16 exact edge-pair intersections; deduplicate; monotone-chain convex hull; exact shoelace
independence.excluded: invalid/degenerate input battery, FE kernel, solver, LF/N19 source execution, obstacle unions, self-contact, arbitrary nonconvex geometry

zero_area_boundary.exact_zero: oracle distinguishes empty, point/edge contact (area exactly zero), and positive area, for the exact supplied float inputs
zero_area_boundary.floating_zero: a production binary64 value of 0 is not a universal proof of no overlap; this finite experiment separately checks exact-zero classification
zero_area_boundary.numerical_tolerance: the 1e-12 normalized area-error test alone does not certify zero overlap: tiny_positive_area_below_error_allowance has a positive exact area below this allowance
zero_area_boundary.overlap_policy: production overlap_tolerance is frozen at 0 for these nondegenerate dyadic samples; physical admissibility tolerances for other tasks remain separate
